suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Update TDD worker skill to clarify Red phase for test-only features: 'For test-only features that validate already-implemented code, the Red phase is writing the tests. Tests should pass immediately against the existing implementation — this is expected. The Green phase confirms all tests pass. Do not force tests to fail artificially.'
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: wrapper-robustness-tests worker reported in skillFeedback: 'The TDD skill says to verify tests FAIL first (Red phase), but for test-only features testing existing code, the tests should pass immediately.' The skill's Step 2.4 says 'Verify they FAIL (Red phase). If they pass without implementation, the tests are testing the wrong thing — fix the tests.' This guidance is incorrect for test-only features.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Consider adding lint coverage for tests/ directory. Currently services.yaml lint command is 'uv run ruff check src/' which excludes tests/. Pre-existing ruff violations exist in tests/test_provider.py (I001, F401, B011) and tests/test_router.py (I001, F401, SIM117) — 10 total errors. Workers creating test files aren't catching lint issues because the lint command doesn't cover their output.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: wrapper-robustness-tests reviewer flagged: 'services.yaml lint command only checks src/'. Running 'uv run ruff check tests/' reveals 10 pre-existing errors across test_provider.py and test_router.py from phase-1-core and phase-3-agents workers.
